data.name: ChunkIdMalformed
data.value: The chunk id is malformed.

data.name: ChunkIdTampered
data.value: The chunk id digest does not match its payload.

data.name: ChunkOutOfRange
data.value: The chunk ordinal is outside the exact index snapshot. Run search_code again for a current id.

data.name: ChunkPathOutsideRoot
data.value: The indexed source path escapes the repository root.

data.name: ChunkPathReparsePoint
data.value: The indexed source path contains a symbolic link or reparse point.

data.name: ChunkSourceMissing
data.value: The indexed source file no longer exists.

data.name: ChunkSourceStaleContent
data.value: The source file no longer matches the indexed content. Run search_code again for a current id.

data.name: ChunkSourceStaleRange
data.value: The indexed line range no longer exists in the source file. Run search_code again for a current id.

data.name: ChunkSourceUnavailable
data.value: The indexed source file is unavailable.

data.name: ChunkStaleGeneration
data.value: The chunk id belongs to a generation that is no longer active. Run search_code again for a current id.
data.comment: The closing clause is new: the six stale cases named no action at all, and the action is always the same one.

data.name: ChunkStaleOverlay
data.value: The worktree overlay changed after this chunk id was issued. Run search_code again for a current id.

data.name: ChunkStaleWorktree
data.value: The worktree tree changed after this chunk id was issued. Run search_code again for a current id.

data.name: ChunkWrongRepository
data.value: The chunk id belongs to another repository.

data.name: GenerationNotPublished
data.value: No index generation is published for this repository. Build one: localai sync --root {0}
data.comment: localai sync and --root are typed, so they stay as they are; {0} is a path and never moves.

data.name: GenerationWithoutSemanticIndex
data.value: Generation '{0}' has no semantic.sidx, so definitions and references are answered by bounded text matching. Sync again to build it: localai sync --root {1}
data.comment: The second clause is the wording CodeSearchText.NavigationHeuristicMissing already uses for the same fact on the Navigation: line; two spellings of one fact is how they drift. It replaces 'Rebuild it with semantic indexing enabled', which named a route no option offers: localai sync takes no such flag, and the real cause is a generation published before semantic indexing existed.

data.name: IndexBelongsToAnotherRepository
data.value: The published index belongs to another repository, so nothing here was searched. Sync this one: localai sync --root {0}

data.name: IndexNotBuilt
data.value: No index at '{0}'. Build it: localai sync --root <repo>
data.comment: It used to recommend codesearch index, which writes a file in place and publishes no generation; the MCP tool answers this identical state with localai sync, and so does this binary three hundred lines away. Two build commands in one binary is the drift.

data.name: IndexPredatesSnapshotIds
data.value: This index was built before chunk ids were bound to a snapshot. Rebuild it: localai sync --root {0}

data.name: ModelNotCalibrated
data.value: Semantic relevance threshold not calibrated for embedding model '{0}'.
data.comment: The English is unchanged to the character: README.md quotes 'threshold not calibrated' as a literal, and two tests assert on it.

data.name: NoSymbolAtPosition
data.value: The semantic index has no symbol at this position, so these are bounded text matches rather than resolved references.
data.comment: Not a refusal but a degradation note, and it lands in the same slot as the three above — left English it would reproduce this defect one line lower.

data.name: OverlayBaseMismatch
data.value: The semantic overlay was built against a different base generation than the one published now. Run localai sync in this worktree.
data.comment: overlay stays Latin and indeclinable in Russian, as docs/overview.ru.md already writes it.

data.name: OverlayMissing
data.value: No overlay matches this worktree as it is now, so no stale or mixed result was returned. Build one: localai sync --root {0}
data.comment: It used to end 'Diagnose/restart MCP, use the LocalAi CLI through the same broker, or continue with rg', which named nothing the reader could type and contradicted ConsoleJson's own comment that this state is answered by syncing this worktree and that the message says so. Now it does.

data.name: SemanticIndexUnreadable
data.value: The semantic index for generation '{0}' could not be read. Rebuild it: localai sync --root {1}
data.comment: The cause it used to interpolate is now the InnerException: none of the twenty ways to be unreadable changes what the reader does, and 'Semantic index ended inside a document hash' is not a sentence to put in front of anybody.

data.name: SnapshotMismatch
data.value: The semantic index snapshot does not match the requested repository generation and worktree. Run localai sync in this worktree.
data.comment: No path hole: neither call site has a working root to name, and threading one through for a --root the reader may omit is not worth the parameter.
